hook.name: FireballHook
hook.description: A deflation hook for the $FIRE token that takes a 1.2% fee on all swaps: ETH fees from buys accumulate in a buyback pot (triggered every 10 swaps via burnThemAll()), while token fees from sells are immediately burned. An allowlist gating sell-side swaps can be activated by anyone (burner()) and is controlled by the deployer (fireBallSeeds()).
